Q1 k=5 independent recomputation report

Exact two-cell construction: for candidate TV d, e=(1-d)/2. For each law i, U_i is the one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper endpoint BetaInv(0.975; e*n_i+1, n_i-e*n_i). The lower witness is max(0, 1-min(U_a,0.5)-min(U_b,0.5)). T_exact(n) is the equal-n bisection crossing where this witness exceeds 0.05. The reported guarantee convention is per-cell alpha=0.025; the union over the two laws is 95% for this lower construction. This is an exact numerical inversion of the stated construction, not the calibrated 1.958 approximation.
